climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A cool-climate region around Canberra, in the Southern New South Wales zone, in a triangle with Yass, Bungendore and Murrumbateman as key places. Lower, inland parts near Yass are warmer than the high ground near Bungendore. Shiraz is 32 percent of plantings, with Riesling at 12.
